note: City of Sheffield park on the upper level of Galvin Park above the West Fork Cedar River, next to the golf course: shelter with fireplace, swing set, and a SafeT Home cabin for rent. Electric only; water is for filling tanks. Sledding hill in winter. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $15, 10 electric sites, modern shower house, Apr 1 - Oct 15, City Hall phone booking with 2-night weekend minimum (3 on holidays). Fit: the gravel pads are ~20 m deep on NAIP with an RV parked on one, so a 23-ft rig fits. Presence: live city page (c) 2026 with phone; Google 4.0/9. Amperage not stated (stored 30 left alone). Not waterfront confirmed; pin fine.
